verdict.rationale: CrewAI documents a REST API for deployed crews, with POST /kickoff, GET /status and POST /resume. Its code-first framework and CLI let users create, run and manage crews and flows outside the UI. However, nothing shows that the AMP UI features (Crew Studio, the Visual Agent/Task Builders, one-click deployment, the Tool Repository) have API equivalents, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented API parity for Crew Studio and the visual builders, API/CLI-driven deployment, API management of the Tool Repository, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Access your deployed crews via REST API for integration with existing systems
[POST /resume](https://docs.crewai.com/v1.15.23/en/api-reference/resume.md): Resume crew execution with human feedback
The CrewAI CLI provides a set of commands to interact with CrewAI, allowing you to create, train, run, and manage crews & flows.
